title: Synapse Staining in Mouse Brain Sections
author: Shiyi Wang

steps.title: Wash Brain Sections
steps.instruction: Wash 40 μm free-floating mouse brain sections containing the visual cortex in 1x TBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (TBST).

steps.title: Block Non-Specific Binding
steps.instruction: Incubate sections in 10% normal goat serum (NGS) diluted in TBST for 1 hour at room temperature.

steps.title: Incubate Primary Antibodies
steps.instruction: Incubate sections with rabbit anti-PSD95 (1:300) and guineapig anti-Bassoon (1:500) primary antibodies diluted in blocking buffer (10% NGS in TBST) for 2 nights at 4 °C with gentle shaking.

steps.title: Wash and Nuclear Staining
steps.instruction: Wash sections with TBST three times for 10 minutes each, adding DAPI (1:5000) to the second wash for nuclear staining.

steps.title: Incubate Secondary Antibodies
steps.instruction: Incubate sections in Alexa Fluor 488 goat anti-rabbit IgG(H+L) and Alexa Fluor 647 goat anti-guineapig IgG(H+L) secondary antibodies, diluted 1:100 in TBST, for 3 hours at room temperature in the dark.

steps.title: Wash Sections
steps.instruction: Wash sections with TBST three times for 10 minutes each.

steps.title: Mount and Cure Slides
steps.instruction: Mount sections onto glass slides using Mowiol and allow slides to cure overnight at room temperature in the dark.

steps.title: Acquire Z-Stack Images
steps.instruction: Capture high-magnification z-stack images using a fluorescent microscope (e.g., Zeiss LSM 880) within 2 days for optimal results.

substeps.instruction: Use a 63× objective plus 1.6× optical zoom.
Capture 3 optical sections spaced 0.34 μm apart per z-stack.
Ensure consistent imaging settings for all conditions.

steps.title: Identify and Quantify Synapses
steps.instruction: Identify excitatory synapses by the colocalization of pre-synaptic (Bassoon) and post-synaptic (PSD95) puncta and quantify them using SynBot (ImageJ-based software).
